messages:
Priya Rao: Quick huddle — launching a bundled pricing experiment next week: compact FAQ tweak, two tier name variants, and an inline calculator nudge modal. Aim: raise self-serve signups and reduce low-quality demo leads. Thoughts?
Evan Moore: Love it. Keep tests minimal: 2 naming variants + control, FAQ top-4 Qs, calc as single-field MAU -> est tokens.
Diego Alvarez: Single-field works. Suggest showing an "estimated monthly spend" line under the result and a small CTA: "Start free trial" + "Request demo" secondary.
Clara Zhou: Microcopy: under CTA add "No credit card required" to lower friction. Also call out "Typical use case: chatbots" in the calc so estimates feel relevant. :bulb:
Priya Rao: Good. Routing plan: demo click -> SDR-pricing immediate; estimated spend >= 750 -> SDR-pricing; else -> automated nurture. Can we add a safety net for known accounts?
Evan Moore: Yes — if lead.company_tier == "enterprise" override to SDR. Pseudocode: `if (lead.requested_demo) route('SDR-pricing') else if (lead.company_tier == 'enterprise') route('SDR-pricing') else if (lead.est_spend >= 750) route('SDR-pricing') else route('pricing-nurture')`
Diego Alvarez: Analytics to track: pricing_calc_open, pricing_calc_submit, pricing_est_spend, pricing_variant, routing_assigned. Tag experiment id `pack_sprint_v2`.
Clara Zhou: Webinar tie: 25-min product walkthrough + 10-min benchmark highlight. Benchmark: chat support flow, show % savings with batching & caching vs baseline. Keep numbers relative. I'll draft the 2-slide snippet.
Priya Rao: Timeline: copy + hero badges by Tue; wireframes Wed; dev handoff Thu; canary Fri (5% traffic); full ramp Mon. Assignments: Evan - tier strings & hero badges; Diego - calc mapping + routing PR; Clara - FAQ copy & nurture emails; Priya - launch post + webinar blurb. CI Bot: flag?
CI Bot: feature-flag `pricing-bundle-v2` created. Staging deployment scheduled Fri 18:30 UTC.
Evan Moore: I'll post the exact strings in #docs tonight; keep character limit for badges to 28 chars.
Diego Alvarez: I'll open the lead-routing PR and include the override column idea.
Clara Zhou: Drafting FAQ Q1-4 now, will drop in this thread when ready.
Priya Rao: Great. If something slips we soft-launch FAQ + tier names first, hold calculator. :ok_hand:
